newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria opposition leads presidential race-poll.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria opposition leads presidential race-poll.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov was leading Sunday's presidential election with 41 percent but short of the absolute majority he needs to win, a telephone exit poll by private agency Fakt showed.
Fakt's poll of 1,300 voters across the country put Culture Minister Ivan Marazov, the candidate of the governing Socialists, second with 30 percent.
The Fakt poll, quoted by Darik private radio, placed George Ganchev of the Bulgarian Business Bloc third with 20 percent.
The electoral commission estimated turnout at 60 percent of the 6.75 million electorate by 5 p.m. (1500 GMT) and said voting had been extended beyond the scheduled 7 p.m. closing time.
A second round is scheduled for next Sunday if official final results show no candidate has an absolute majority.
